set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { app: "sap-order-system-api", status: "OK", message: "SAP ECC connection verified via RFC_PING", host: p("sap.applicationServerHost"), client: p("sap.client") }]
set-payload.doc:name: OK response

logger.message: #["Order failed SAP validation — not submitted: " ++ write(vars.validation.messages, "application/json")]
logger.doc:name: log validation fail

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { validated: false, submitted: false, salesDocument: "", mechanism: "Validate: BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2 (TESTRUN='X') — rejected before submit", validationMessages: vars.validation.messages, submissionMessages: [] }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var r = payload.BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2 var msgs = (r.tables.RETURN.*row default []) map { messageType: ($.TYPE default "") as String, id: ($.ID default "") as String, number: ($.NUMBER default "") as String, message: ($.MESSAGE default "") as String } --- { salesDocument: ((r.export.SALESDOCUMENT default r.SALESDOCUMENT) default "") as String, hasError: !isEmpty(msgs filter ((m) -> m.messageType == "E" or m.messageType == "A")), messages: msgs }

logger.message: #["Submit failed after passing validation — rolled back: " ++ write(vars.createResult.messages, "application/json")]
logger.doc:name: log rollback

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { validated: true, submitted: (vars.committed default false), salesDocument: vars.createResult.salesDocument, mechanism: "Validate: BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2 (TESTRUN='X') -> Submit: BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2 + BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT", validationMessages: vars.validation.messages, submissionMessages: vars.createResult.messages }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "SAP_UNAVAILABLE", errorType: (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), message: (error.description default "SAP ECC could not be reached"), retryable: true }
